# vendored from thisisait/design

`iris-eye.js` and `iris-tone.js` are copied verbatim from
https://github.com/thisisait/design (`src/js/`), last synced at commit `acfdad7`.
They are classic scripts that assign `window.AIT`; `ait.d.ts` types the parts the
site uses. Do not edit here — change them in the design repo and run
`tools/sync-design.sh ../design`.
